Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, VirtualViewSocket, Runnable
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements Runnable, VirtualViewSocket
Server-side handler for a single Socket client connection.

One instance is created per accepted Socket and run on its own thread (implements Runnable). It plays two roles:

  1. Command receiver: run() continuously reads JSON lines from the client, deserialises each into a ClientCommand via Jackson's polymorphic type resolution, and calls ClientCommand.execute(SocketClientHandler) passing this as the handler — giving the command access to getController(), getServer(), and getNickname().
  2. VirtualViewSocket: the show*/reportError methods wrap their argument in the corresponding ServerNotification subclass, serialise it to JSON, and write it to the client's output stream.

When the read loop ends (client disconnects or an IOException occurs), the finally block in run() performs full cleanup: it terminates the client's game via GameController.handleClientDisconnect(String), notifies the remaining players ("companions") that the game has ended, unregisters this client from MesosServer, and closes the socket.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Main read loop for this client's connection, run on a dedicated thread.

      Each line read from the socket is deserialised into a ClientCommand (the "type" field selects the concrete subclass) and executed immediately. The loop ends when the client closes the connection or an IOException occurs.

      On exit, if this client had completed a join (i.e. nickname is set), the finally block tears down the client's game: it calls GameController.handleClientDisconnect(String) to obtain the remaining players ("companions"), notifies them via MesosServer.broadcastErrorToGame(List, String) that the game has been terminated, and unregisters this client from MesosServer. The socket is then closed regardless of whether a nickname was set.

      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • showInitialSnapshot

      public void showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot snapshot)
      Pushes a full game snapshot to this client, replacing its local state entirely.

      Used both when a game starts (broadcast to all players) and when a player reconnects after a server crash (sent individually).

      Wraps snapshot in an InitialSnapshotNotification and sends it as a JSON line.

      Specified by:
